text:
Marta R: quick one — I added a 2-line clarification to docs/runtime/env.md about env var precedence (process env -> config file -> secrets manager). can someone sanity-check the wording? not sure we should mention KMS specifics.
Alex P: can you drop the link to the PR? I'll take a look :eyes:
Marta R: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — snippet included below
Marta R: ```diff
+Note: for private deployments, env vars set on the host override values in config files.
+Secrets fetched via KMS/HSM are preferred for long-lived keys; we don't prescribe a vendor.
```
Samir: small nit — suggest moving the 'Note' under the 'Configuration precedence' header so it flows with examples. Also the KMS sentence could be 'vendor-agnostic' so it doesn't look prescriptive.
Leo C: fyi the screenshot under the same section 404s in staging preview, saw a 403 when opening, might need rehost.
Marta R: ah, thanks. I rehosted the screenshot to our static-cdn and updated the link in the PR. PR now references https://static.redwood.internal/runtime/env-precedence.png
Alex P: took a quick pass — wording LGTM after Samir's placement change. left 2 tiny comments in PR.
docs-bot: PR 4321 merged into main by marta — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abcd1234 :tada:
Marta R: awesome, thanks all. I'll include a short note in this sprint's changelog. cc @Alex P @Samir
Samir: cool, thanks. no followups from me.
Leo C: verified image serves in staging now. :thumbsup:
Alex P: done. moving to close the task.
